integrity.claim_and_proof_scope: all positive integers with explicit one/two-point boundaries

scientific_limitations: Only all nonempty subgroup cosets of a finite cyclic group, not arbitrary unions or noncyclic groups.
Historical priority under alternative residue-class/quotient-fiber terminology is not independently established.
Finite computation supports but does not substitute for the all-modulus proof.
title: Prime-private shattering and the complete coset profile of finite cyclic groups
